```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state = "TX",
  year = 2020,
  survey = "acs5",
  geometry = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
ggplot(income_tx) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name = "Median household income (USD)",
    labels = scales::label_dollar()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Household Income Across Texas Counties",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 ACS 5-year estimates"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "gray40"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false
edu_state <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c(
    total = "B15003_001",
    bachelors = "B15003_022",
    masters = "B15003_023",
    professional = "B15003_024",
    doctorate = "B15003_025"
  ),
  year = 2020,
  survey = "acs5",
  summary_var = "B15003_001"
)
```

```{r}
edu_state_summary <- edu_state |>
  group_by(GEOID, NAME) |>
  summarize(
    total = first(summary_est),
    bachelors_plus = sum(
      estimate[variable %in% c("bachelors", "masters", "professional", "doctorate")],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(percent_bachelors_plus = 100 * bachelors_plus / total) |>
  arrange(desc(percent_bachelors_plus))

ggplot(
  edu_state_summary,
  aes(
    x = percent_bachelors_plus,
    y = reorder(NAME, percent_bachelors_plus)
  )
) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)) +
labs(
  x = "Adults with a bachelor's degree or higher",
  y = NULL,
  title = "Bachelor's Degree or Higher by State",
  caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 ACS 5-year estimates"
) +
theme_minimal() +
theme(
  plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
  plot.caption = element_text(color = "gray40"),
  panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
age_ca <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = c(
    median_age = "B01002_001",
    population = "B01003_001"
  ),
  state = "CA",
  year = 2020,
  survey = "acs5",
  geometry = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
age_ca_wide <- age_ca |>
  select(GEOID, NAME, variable, estimate) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = variable,
    values_from = estimate
  )

ggplot(age_ca_wide, aes(x = population, y = median_age)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    data = slice_max(age_ca_wide, population, n = 5),
    aes(label = str_remove(NAME, ", California")),
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = -0.5,
    check_overlap = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    x = "County population (log scale)",
    y = "Median age (years)",
    title = "Population and Median Age Across California Counties",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 ACS 5-year estimates"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "gray40")
  )
```
